use: Heat and stir solutions in beakers / flasks; a temperature probe can be inserted for control.
simulation: Plate temperature follows power and heat loss, containers approach plate temperature via heat-transfer coefficient; stirring sets how fast mixing and dissolution go.
notes: Reference model profile: heating magnetic stirrer
Spec values compiled from memory of public product literature, not yet checked item by item against the manual (verified = false).

comms.notes: Example commands IN_PV_1 / OUT_SP_1 / START_1 / STOP_1 / IN_PV_4 / OUT_SP_4 / START_4 / STOP_4; the manual is authoritative

set_temperature.description: Set heating target temperature. Controls on liquid temperature when the PT1000 probe is inserted, otherwise on plate temperature.
